prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 1024x1536 opaque anime character-rig sprite.
Input roles: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL and ONLY edit target, sleeve-left-v6.png. Image 2, left-front-template.png, is the hand-design reference ONLY. Image 3 is an intermediate hand-redraw attempt; use ONLY its correctly counted FIVE digits as anatomy guidance. Do not copy Image 3's too-long fingers or textured green background.

Make exactly one local edit to Image 1: redraw its bare hand as a TINY, COMPACT, SOFT CHILD'S HAND. The whole visible hand, including palm, fingers, and thumb, must occupy approximately 186 pixels wide by 144 pixels high on this 1024x1536 canvas. The large original hand measures about 301x229; the intermediate Image 3 hand is still too tall at 194x174. The final hand must be shorter than Image 3 by about 30 pixels, especially by shortening its fingers. Four very short, softly rounded fingers and a separate even shorter thumb; a short rounded palm. Exactly FIVE visible digits, with all FOUR fingertips plus the thumb tip present and countable. Close relaxed finger spacing, slight natural gaps, gentle knuckle shading and subtle colourless nails. It should hang softly down-left; no stiff wide splay.

Wrist attachment: preserve the original wrist center approximately (275,1252), following the exact original diagonal cuff opening. The small wrist is narrower than the big cuff and emerges from the middle of it. Inset the two sides of the wrist along the UNCHANGED cuff opening so the smaller hand does not fill the entire width of the cuff. Keep a clean natural attachment with no visible green gap between cuff and wrist. The final visible bare hand should fit approximately inside x=130..316 and y=1230..1374. Those are invisible construction coordinates, never draw them.

Pixel preservation is essential for rigging. Take all original sleeve and cuff pixels directly from Image 1, WITHOUT rerendering them. Preserve the full original 1024x1536 framing and exact shoulder/sleeve/cuff contour, position, angle, scale, rotation, folds, highlights, shading, both purple bands, square keeper, pale pink/cyan glitch specks, cuff stripes, and outline. No sleeve shifts, shape adjustments, repainting, added grain or texture, or resampling. This is an edit of only the flesh hand area and its vacated silhouette.

Erase every remnant of the old oversized hand. The background must be a single perfectly flat, opaque chroma-green fill, exact sRGB RGB(18,240,14), hex #12F00E, all background pixels one identical colour. NO visual texture, gradients, mottling, grain, colour variation, shadow or lighting on the green.
Keep the original refined soft 2D anime cel shading and restrained linework on the hand. No text, labels, extra objects, watermark, checkerboard or alpha. Output exactly one sleeve and one small five-digit hand, full canvas 1024x1536.

The hand hangs relaxed diagonally toward the lower left at the original wrist angle; fingers are loosely and gently spread, not stiff, not extended widely and not clenched. Match the small gentle proportions of Image 2's hand. No long thin fingers or adult-size hand. Preserve the refined soft 2D anime cel shading and restrained purple/reddish outline style appropriate to the original hand.

validation.hand_measurement_method: Bounding box of warm skin-colour pixels below y=1210 and left of x=350; excludes some dark outline pixels.
validation.protected_sleeve_measurement: Source foreground colour mask above y=1200, compared in place.
limitations: Generated hand is close to, but not exactly, the requested footprint.
Sleeve remains visually close but its pixels were rerendered.
Output background contains colour variation and does not equal the requested RGB.
No pixel editing or compositing was performed after built-in generation.

post_process: Background flattened after generation: keyed with the cutout tool, then recomposited over the texture's chroma value. Subject pixels unchanged; the sha256 here is the flattened file in the repo.
